title: The Spark Within
description: Helvant has turned away three would-be students this year, each one certain of a spark that wasn't there. He has outlived two apprentices who never got past their first real spell, and there is no Circle behind him to absorb a bad choice - just an old man and however many years he has left to teach in. Bring him a moonpetal from the Crossroads shrine and silver dust cut from something undead you put down yourself, and he'll know inside the hour whether you're worth the time.

objectives.description: Find a moonpetal flower at the Crossroads shrine - the easy half of the test
objectives.notes: Test of awareness - can you find rare magical reagents?

objectives.description: Cut silver dust from something undead you've put down yourself
objectives.notes: Test of will - can you face supernatural foes?

objectives.description: Bring both back and let Helvant judge you on them

notes: Distinct from the Arcane Circle's mage_01: this is a lone master risking his own remaining years, not an institution risking its budget. Threat: none yet - a door, same shape as mage_01. Giver motive: Helvant has already buried two apprentices who didn't make it and turned away three hopefuls this year; he is old and has no time left to spend on a fourth false start. Consequence: unwired - fail and the quest simply doesn't complete, no data-side rejection is modeled, though the prose states he's turned others away for less. First quest in wizard apprentice chain.
